audit.summary: The 320×480 ad creative shows critical structural and branding issues across all states. Primary blockers include: (1) incorrect ad container ID ('ad-320x480' required but may not be present), (2) missing LEGO brand logo in settled state (only red square visible), (3) inconsistent color strategy (yellow in initial/animated vs red in settled—neither fully matches primary palette #E3000B/#FFED00/#000000/#FFFFFF), (4) typography hierarchy issues with French copy, (5) product imagery quality and scale concerns, and (6) carousel/state management appears broken (settled state is completely different composition, suggesting missing layout continuity). The ad transitions from a trophy-focused state to a player legends state, but lacks visual cohesion and proper branding lockup. Minor issues include button styling inconsistency and pagination dot clarity.

findings.issue: Missing or incorrect ad container ID. The HTML must declare id="ad-320x480" on the main ad wrapper element to enable format targeting and QA validation.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure index.html has a root div or container with id="ad-320x480" wrapping all ad content. This is mandatory for ad format identification.

findings.issue: LEGO brand logo missing in settled state. Only a small red square is visible; the official LEGO logo/wordmark should be prominently displayed. The 'Insiders' or 'House' logos referenced in style guide are not present.
findings.fix_hint: Add the official LEGO logo SVG or PNG to the settled/hero state. Use one of the provided logoFileUrls (brand-legoinsiders-black.svg or logo-lego-house.jpg). Position it at top-left or top-center with appropriate padding and scale (minimum 60px height recommended for 320px width).

findings.issue: Color palette inconsistency: initial/animated states use bright yellow (#FFED00 or similar) as primary background, but settled state switches to red (#E3000B or similar). This breaks brand consistency and appears as two separate ad campaigns rather than one cohesive creative.
findings.fix_hint: Choose one primary color for the entire carousel experience or establish a clear, intentional color progression. If using yellow→red transition, implement as smooth animation with easing. Otherwise, standardize on red (#E3000B) as the primary brand color per style guide, keeping yellow (#FFED00) for accent elements (CTA buttons, highlights) only.

findings.issue: Typography hierarchy unclear in French copy. 'TROPHÉE MONDIAL' (initial) and 'LÉGENDES DU FOOT' (settled) use bold sans-serif but lack consistent sizing, weight, or spacing relative to body copy and CTAs. Cera Pro (weight 800 for headlines) usage is not evident.
findings.fix_hint: Apply Cera Pro Bold (weight 800) to all French hero titles (h1 level). Define clear size ratios: headline 32-40px, subheading (Cera Pro 500) 18-20px, body (Arial 400) 14-16px. Ensure minimum 1.5x line-height for readability on mobile. Test at actual 320px width.

findings.issue: Product image quality and scale inconsistent. Trophy image in initial state is small and poorly integrated; player LEGO sets in settled state lack clear product hierarchy and appear cramped. No clear visual focus on hero product.
findings.fix_hint: Redesign layout to give hero product image at least 40-50% of vertical space in 320px format. Use high-quality product images from productPictureUrls. Ensure image has clean white or brand-color background. Apply consistent padding/margin (16px minimum on mobile). Verify images load correctly and scale proportionally.

findings.issue: Carousel/state management appears broken. Settled state is radically different composition (hero layout → product grid) with no visual continuity. Pagination dots visible but carousel behavior is unclear—animation state shows no visible change from initial, suggesting animation not rendering.
findings.fix_hint: Rebuild carousel logic: (1) Ensure initial state shows Trophy with yellow background and 'Découvrir' CTA. (2) Animate to settled state with smooth fade/slide transition (250-400ms easing). (3) Settled state should show product legends with red background and 'Voir la collection' CTA. (4) Implement visible pagination indicators (filled/outline dots) that highlight current slide. (5) Add autoplay (5-7s per slide) with user pause/resume on interaction.

findings.issue: CTA button styling inconsistent between states. 'Découvrir →' (initial, red pill button) differs in size/padding from 'Voir la collection' (settled, yellow button). No clear hover/active states visible.
findings.fix_hint: Standardize button dimensions: min-height 44px (touch target), padding 12px 24px, border-radius 24px (pill shape). Use Arial Bold (weight 700) for CTA text. Initial state: red (#E3000B) button with white text. Settled state: yellow (#FFED00) button with black text. Add hover state (10% darkening or opacity shift) and active/pressed state (scale 0.95). Ensure sufficient contrast (white on red = 5.25:1, black on yellow = 19.56:1).

findings.issue: Pagination dots visibility poor. In initial state, dots appear faint/low-contrast against yellow background. Current active dot not clearly distinguished from inactive dots.
findings.fix_hint: Redesign pagination indicator: use dark (near-black or #333) filled dot for active slide, light gray (#CCC) or outlined dot for inactive. Min size 8-10px diameter with 8px spacing. Place 16px from bottom. Ensure contrast ratio ≥3:1 against background. Consider adding a subtle animation (scale or opacity pulse) on the active dot.

findings.issue: French copy localization incomplete. 'Insiders' appears in English in logo area; breadcrumb or context not visible. No clear call-to-action reinforcement for French-speaking audience.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure all visible text is French: 'TROPHÉE MONDIAL', 'LÉGENDES DU FOOT', 'Construis le trophée mythique', 'Découvrir', 'Voir la collection'. Add micro-copy beneath hero title in French (e.g., 'Les légendes du football en LEGO'). Verify no English fragments remain visible in settled or animated states.

findings.issue: Product set names (MESSI, RONALDO) displayed in initial state but other two legends (Mbappé, Vinícius Jr) not visible. Settled state only shows 2 of 4 hero sets, reducing visibility of full product line.
findings.fix_hint: In settled state, consider a scrollable/carousel layout for all four legend sets, or use a 2×2 grid if space allows in 320px height. Ensure all four products (Messi, Ronaldo, Mbappé, Vinícius Jr) are represented. Add set numbers (43011, 43012, 43013, 43027) or set type labels (Football Highlights vs Football Legend) to aid product discovery.

audit.regeneration_prompt: Regenerate the complete 320×480 ad creative with the following mandatory fixes: (1) Ensure index.html declares id="ad-320x480" on the main ad container. (2) Add official LEGO logo (brand-legoinsiders-black.svg or logo-lego-house.jpg) to the settled state hero area, positioned top-center with 60px minimum height and appropriate padding. (3) Standardize color scheme: use yellow (#FFED00) for initial/animated states as bright attention-getter, then transition to red (#E3000B) for settled state as bold brand reinforcement. Ensure smooth CSS animation between states (fade or slide, 250-400ms ease-out). (4) Apply Cera Pro Bold (weight 800) to all French hero titles ('TROPHÉE MONDIAL' and 'LÉGENDES DU FOOT') at 32-40px size; use Cera Pro Medium (weight 500) for sub-copy at 18-20px; use Arial Regular (weight 400) for body at 14-16px. Minimum line-height 1.5 for mobile readability. (5) Redesign product layout: initial state should show trophy image centered (40-50% of vertical space) with 'Construis le trophée mythique' copy and red 'Découvrir →' CTA button (44px height, 24px pill radius). Settled state should display all four legend sets in a 2×2 or scrollable carousel layout (Messi 43011, Ronaldo 43012, Mbappé 43013, Vinícius Jr 43027) on red background with 'LÉGENDES DU FOOT' hero title and yellow 'Voir la collection' CTA. (6) Implement carousel with visible pagination (8-10px dots, dark filled for active, light outlined for inactive, 8px spacing) positioned 16px from bottom. Add autoplay logic (5-7s per slide) with pause on hover/interaction. (7) Ensure button consistency: 44px minimum height, 12-24px padding, Arial Bold text, proper contrast (white text on red ≥5:1, black text on yellow ≥19:1). Add hover state (10% darkening) and active state (0.95 scale). (8) Remove all English text fragments; verify all visible copy is French only. Add contextual micro-copy reinforcing product appeal ('Les légendes du football en LEGO' or similar). (9) Center the entire 320×480 ad unit on page using body flexbox (min-height 100vh, display flex, justify-content center, align-items center). Test at actual 320px viewport width on mobile device or browser DevTools. (10) Ensure all product images are high-quality, properly scaled, and load from productPictureUrls with correct aspect ratios. Apply consistent 16px padding/margin on mobile. Verify no pixelation or distortion at 320px width.
